// diagnostic E3209

Jet.CLibraryNotLinked

The linker couldn't find C library `{lib}`.

What

The linker couldn't find C library `{lib}`.

Why

Your program links against `{lib}`, but the linker reported `cannot find -l{lib}` — the library isn't on the link search path. A `jet build` run reports this C boundary or linker diagnostic.

Fix

Declare it in `deps:` so Jet provisions it: `{lib}: c@system` (host pkg-config, else fetched from nixpkgs), or `{lib}: c@nixpkgs:<attr>` to pick the nixpkgs attribute, or install the system package.
